summary: FE Sell Price Not Updating When Average Cost or Category Is Changed on parts tab
reported_issue: On the Work Order Parts tab, when adding/editing a part the sell price did not recalculate when the cost was changed or when the category was selected/changed.
expected_after_fix: Sell price recalculates immediately when the cost is changed and when the category (markup) is changed.
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin, opened a Work Order Parts tab (/part-requests) with inline-editable part rows.
Cost change test: set a part's cost to 123.45 and to 100 and read the sell price after each.
Category change test: with cost=100, opened the part's category dropdown and selected different categories, reading the sell price after each.
actual_now: Sell price recalculates correctly. Setting cost=123.45 produced sell=274.33; setting cost=100 produced sell=222.22 (default markup applied). Changing the category to '70%override' recalculated sell to 170.00 (= 100 x 1.70, i.e. the 70% category markup). Both cost changes and category changes drive an immediate sell-price recalculation.
notes: Tested inline on the Parts tab (input_cost_*, input_sell_price_*, select_part_category_*). The change to a 70%-markup category yielded a sell of exactly cost*1.70, confirming category-driven recalculation.
